dedupe_keys.name: d7 5 report on sewer system hydraulic performance in networks with defects and deteriorating assets

description: Simon Tait and colleagues at the University of Sheffield describe implemented code that inserts individual defects into SWMM sewer models. Invert sediment blockage and soffit intrusions are assessed through local and network flood volumes. Coverage comprises two UK catchments: a 195-node combined system draining about 55 hectares and a larger network with over 4,000 nodes draining about 925 hectares. Rainfall intensity and defect size are varied; the large case uses one measured event scaled to different volumes. Zenodo supplies the report freely under CC BY 4.0. The related SWMM platform supplies general hydraulic simulation, while this record describes the defect experiment model. A limitation is that code availability is not established by the report deposit, and results for one scaled event do not constitute a general probabilistic flood-risk assessment. Report bodies and simulations were not accessed.
